evidence.observation: Exhaust oxygen was 4.1 ppm at growth onset.
Oxygen rose persistently through 13.1, 19.6 and 26.5 ppm at 2760, 2880 and 3000 s, indicating an atmosphere deviation.
Temperature 750.1 °C and argon flow 99.4 sccm remain near their setpoints despite rising oxygen.
Tube pressure gauge is not installed; pressure remains unavailable, preventing verification of the required growth-stage pressure.

args.missing_evidence: A valid tube-pressure measurement is required to verify the growth atmosphere; independent oxygen verification and leak/exhaust-path checks are needed to identify the cause of the oxygen rise. Sample characterization is not yet available.
